title: fleet-write: add an op that sets an issue's type (Bug / Feature / Task), for the area rollouts in objectstack and cloud
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: the maintainer's choice of option A on 「卡片类型怎么设到卡上」 (2026-11-18 16:15Z, in the cloud priorities discussion): add a relay op that sets the issue type. Filed here because the relay lives in this repo (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/`); both area rollouts need it: cloud#4869 (child cloud#4871) and objectstack#35205 (child #35208, which met the same gap). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changes

- A new op in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, e.g. `issue_type_set` `{issue, type}`, `type` one of `Bug`, `Feature`, `Task` (the organization's issue type names; reject anything else before any request).
- Request: `PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}` with `{"type": "<name>"}` (the issue-update endpoint's `type` field). Permission `issues`.
- Read-back: the issue's `type.name` equals the requested name; otherwise the action fails with what was read.
- Works on both `objectstack-ai/objectstack` and `objectstack-ai/cloud`.
- Self-test row in the existing fleet-write self-tests, and the op listed wherever the op roster is documented (pm-dispatch references).

## Open point to check first

Whether the relay's app installation can set issue types at all (organization issue types must be enabled and named Bug / Feature / Task; the org issue-types read answers 403 to session tokens). If the app cannot, say so on this card and to the maintainer before building anything.

## Done when

- The op lands; one trial on a cloud card and one on an objectstack card read back the type.
- Scope: new cards only. The maintainer, 2026-11-18 16:16Z: 「历史卡先回填，这个字段可以空着」. Existing cards keep an empty type field; there is no type backfill.
